headline: GTA Online Event Week: Brand War (August 13th-20th)
quickTake: NEW DLC: The Kortz Center Heist is live — plan the art heist from a Mansion Art Studio
4x GTA$ & RP on Hotring Circuit Series

sections.title: New DLC: The Kortz Center Heist

items.label: Hosting the heist? Buy a Mansion via Dynasty 8 — Tongva Estate, Vinewood Residence or Richman Villa, from GTA$11.5M
Add the Art Studio expansion (GTA$4.7M — as low as GTA$2.7M with the Elitist and GTA+ discounts) to unlock the heist planning board
Run The Kortz Center Heist (solo or up to 4 players) — three new paintings rotate every week, so it repeats as a money-maker
No mansion? Join a friend's Kortz Center Heist crew — only the host needs the property
4x GTA$ & RP on Hotring Circuit Series
The GTA Online Weekly Challenge for this week is "Complete three Business Battles"
Claim Sprunk and eCola Bodysuits for free at all Clothing Stores
Claim a free Declasse Hotring Sabre (Sports) from Southern San Andreas Super Autos
Log in to claim the Sprunk x eCola livery for the Declasse Hotring Sabre (Sports)
Log in to claim Sprunk and eCola vanity plates at Vehicle Workshops
This week at the Casino in GTA Online, take your daily spin with the lucky wheel for your chance to win the Pfister Astron, which cost $1,580,000 from Legendary Motorsport
This week in GTA Online, place top 4 LS Car Meet Race for 3 days in a row unlock the Enus Deity as the Prize Ride vehicle
This week's GTA Online Premium Test Ride Vehicle is the Karin S95 for PS5, Xbox Series X/S and PC Enhanced players
This week's GTA Online Test Track Vehicles are the Vapid Clique Wagon, Överflöd Autarch & Pegassi Osiris
The FIB Priority File in GTA Online this week is The Black Box File
The Duggan Robbery: Übermacht Sentinel Classic
The GTA Online Luxury Autos Car Dealership located in Rockford Hills has two cars on show for purchase
Simeon's Auto Shop has five cars available to purchase and test drive in GTA Online
This week's Premium Race is A Sign of Things to Come
This week's HSW Time Trial is Terminal
This week's Time Trial is End to End
